gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: Table UI
5 Zones & Inscribing Flow
UI Tour & Basic Inscribing
Deterministic enchanting: pick the exact row you want once material and XP conditions are met.
Place gear, a Book, or an Enchanted Book in the top slot to list valid options.
Place any one accepted material in the bottom slot (pins that cycled option).
Verify the XP badge on the right is lit, then click the row to inscribe.
Book in bottom slot: transfers enchantments for 0 XP, leaving a Depleted Tome.
Click #1–#5 on the right diagram to highlight each UI region.

Combine, Research & Delta
Book Upgrades & Delta Costs
Two routes raise Master Tomes, and upgrades deduct prior costs.
Combine (0 Items): matching book in bag, 0.6× XP, yields 1 Depleted Tome.
Research (1 Book): 1 book + reagent (or Crystal) at 1.4× XP.
Delta Discount: L_cur -> L_new deducts paid items & costs 1–2L w/ Tome.

Epiphanies & Cryo Freeze
Treasures & Epiphany Stasis
Treasure enchants (Mending, Silk Touch, etc.) unlock via two paths:
Path 1 [Master Tome]: store a Treasure book for 1-currency 1–3L crafts.
Path 2 [Grand Library]: %s+ Wooden Shelves roll Epiphanies every 10 min.

XP Bottles require Lv.3+ and >= 11 XP points, preventing XP loops.
Cleansing
Refunds, Strip & Curse Purge
Cleanse, Strip & Curse Purge
Switch to the jade Cleanse tab to reshape any enchanted item or book without starting over:
Disenchant All (Free): clears all non-curse traits for +XP points (curses stay untouched).
Step-Down Downgrade (Free): lower any trait to L' and receive conservation-safe +XP refund.
Targeted Single Strip: use Cleansing Grit (or vanilla option) to remove 1 unwanted trait cleanly.
Purge Curse: spend 2 Grit + Ghast Tear (or Arcane Crystal) + 12L to banish Curses cleanly!
1) Disenchant All (Non-Curse)
0 items · Grants +XP · Books yield Depleted Tome
2) Step-Down Downgrade (L -> L')
0 items · Refunds delta +XP · Zero arbitrage
3) Strip Single Trait
Cleansing Grit + reagent · Keeps all other traits
4) Purge Red Curse
2 Grit + Ghast Tear / Crystal · 12L keeps enchants
